c01s03.title: Three different questions
c01s03.caption: A label cannot replace understanding the actual concern.

c01s03b.title: Observation and diagnosis
c01s03b.caption: A single behaviour is insufficient for diagnosis.

c01s04.title: A proportionate first response
items: A practical option or care route
c01s04.caption: Support can be useful without an amateur diagnosis.

c01s05.title: A clinical claim needs care
c01s05.caption: Clinical terminology should improve care rather than invite casual labeling.

c02s03.title: Category and person
c02s03.caption: Sharing a category does not imply identical causes or treatment needs.

c02s03b.title: Information beyond the category
c02s03b.caption: Dimensions and co-occurrence add clinically relevant information.

c02s04.title: Two evaluation questions
c02s04.caption: Consistent labels still need a justified interpretation.

c02s05.title: Use a category proportionately
items: Not a complete person or cause
c02s05.caption: Classification supports assessment rather than replacing it.

c03s03.title: Different uses
c03s03.caption: A screening result is not a complete clinical conclusion.

c03s03b.title: Ask what the information adds
c03s03b.caption: Evidence is integrated rather than reduced to one score.

c03s04.title: A revisable formulation
c03s04.caption: An individualized account remains a hypothesis rather than a certainty.

c03s05.title: A score needs an interpretation
c03s05.caption: A number is information within a process, not the whole process.

c04s03.title: Different levels of claim
c04s03.caption: The distinction requires more than one episode of worry.

c04s03b.title: A possible maintaining cycle
items: The action may become more likely
c04s03b.caption: This is a clinical hypothesis, not a diagnosis from reluctance.

c04s04.title: A responsible care question
c04s04.caption: Understanding a mechanism does not authorize treating another person.

c04s05.title: Interpret anxiety carefully
c04s05.caption: A process model is not a diagnostic shortcut.

c05s03.title: Understand the pattern
c05s03.caption: A clinical pattern requires more than one feeling or stereotype.

c05s03b.title: A possible bidirectional pattern
c05s03b.caption: A maintaining-cycle hypothesis should guide support without blame.

c05s04.title: A collaborative care decision
c05s04.caption: Treatment is individualized rather than a universal positivity instruction.

c05s05.title: A depression claim needs context
c05s05.caption: Support should be proportionate to the concern and free of blame.

c06s03.title: Different claims
c06s03.caption: A trauma history does not uniquely determine the later outcome.

c06s03b.title: A possible reminder pathway
c06s03b.caption: The pathway is illustrative and does not establish a diagnosis or event detail.

c06s04.title: A proportionate response
c06s04.caption: Support can respect a trauma history without trying to treat it informally.

c06s05.title: Read a trauma claim carefully
c06s05.caption: A reaction should not become an invitation to intrusive investigation.

c07s03.title: Assessment needs alternatives
c07s03.caption: A symptom domain is not a complete diagnosis.

c07s03b.title: Different meanings
c07s03b.caption: The distinction cannot be made from one casual observation.

c07s04.title: A respectful support response
c07s04.caption: A diagnosis does not define an identity or establish dangerousness.

c07s05.title: Avoid a diagnostic shortcut
c07s05.caption: Clinical understanding should reduce stereotypes rather than supply insults.

c08s03.title: Rationale and outcome evidence
c08s03.caption: A persuasive model is not sufficient efficacy evidence.

c08s03b.title: Compare the actual treatment
c08s03b.caption: A broad school name does not specify one uniform intervention.

c08s04.title: A collaborative treatment choice
c08s04.caption: The relationship supports an evidence-informed, revisable plan.

c08s05.title: Evaluate a therapy claim
c08s05.caption: Treatment choices require more specificity than a school or slogan.

c09s03.title: A treatment evaluation
c09s03.caption: Randomization strengthens a bounded causal inference, not a universal guarantee.

c09s03b.title: Invented teaching rates
c09s03b.caption: The absolute difference is twenty percentage points; these are not clinical trial data.

c09s04.title: Read the whole result
c09s04.caption: A treatment decision weighs evidence and individual circumstances.

c09s05.title: A clinical evidence summary
c09s05.caption: A reported average benefit is not an individual prescription.

c10s03.title: A proportionate care route
items: What kind of help is needed?
Which qualified local route is available?
Was the support usable and appropriate?
c10s03.caption: Urgent safety concerns need local urgent services rather than a course response.

c10s03b.title: Questions for care
c10s03b.caption: Preparing a conversation is different from diagnosing or prescribing.

c10s04.title: A responsible final account
c10s04.caption: Clinical understanding supports humane decisions within appropriate boundaries.

c10s05.title: A useful final clinical check
c10s05.caption: An informed next step is a legitimate educational outcome.
